title: Bound subprocess runtime
why: A subprocess without a timeout can block a worker indefinitely when the child hangs or waits for unavailable input.
suggestion: Pass a justified timeout and handle TimeoutExpired at the process boundary.
limitations: Only subprocess.run calls are checked, and an explicit timeout=None remains unbounded.
A directly discarded unchecked call reports py-subprocess-run-unchecked instead, avoiding duplicate findings.
Repeated unbounded subprocess calls are grouped to one representative finding per file.
